items.label: MiCo Q2 FY2026 (08-14-2026)
items.signal_prefix: TSMC is named among MiCo's main customers in its H1 2026 report

set.signal: TSMC is named among MiCo's main customers in its H1 2026 report: the semiconductor cleaning / coating and ceramic-parts business (Komico) names Samsung, SK hynix, Intel, Micron, TSMC, UMC and Global Foundries among the major global customers it trades with, and the main-customer table carries a row 'Intel, TSMC, Micron and others' whose amount is the same as the company's total export sales across all businesses, so no TSMC share is disclosed.

items.reason: The main-customer table does not itself label the rows export / domestic (only the amounts match the export / domestic totals); the explicit customer naming is the Komico business-overview sentence, now cited.
